# AWS Transform

Skills that teach agents to work with AWS Transform. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [awslabs/agent-plugins](https://github.com/awslabs/agent-plugins), at commit `097fe8a`.

Migrate, modernize, and upgrade codebases to AWS.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **AWS Transform**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **AWS Transform**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install aws-transform@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `aws-transform`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

1 script file ship inside the skills. The agent can run it on your machine. Read it first.

5 documents show install commands that pipe a download into a shell (`curl ... | sh`). The agent may suggest them. Read the script before you run it.
